_note: Seed list from the Secretary of State Rules & Regulations department index (rules.sos.ga.gov/gac/). Hand-curated from here: fill agencyType, websiteUrl and the rulemaking.* fields per agency. null = not yet collected (never ''). deptNumber is the stable key; never renumber.

_fieldGuide.name: Cleaned display name (title case, 'Rules of'/'Grants of' prefix removed). Edit freely; sosTitle keeps the source wording.
_fieldGuide.ruleSetKind: 'rules' or 'grants' (SoS lists grant-program descriptions as departments). Consider hiding 'grants' from the rulemaking view.
_fieldGuide.agencyType: suggested: department | board | commission | council | authority | office | other
_fieldGuide.titleTruncated: Present and true where the source title was cut off by the index fetch; verify against rulesUrl.
_fieldGuide.rulemaking.sourceType: agency-notice-page | press-release-listing | rss | sos-posted | pdf-only | none-found
_fieldGuide.rulemaking.platform: e.g. georgia.gov-drupal | wordpress | custom | pdf — lets one scraper cover many agencies
_fieldGuide.rulemaking.noticeUrl: Page that lists notices of intended rulemaking
_fieldGuide.rulemaking.fetchOk: true/false once tested from GitHub Actions (bot-blocking check)
_fieldGuide.rulemaking.commentContact: Where comments are sent, if different from noticeUrl
_fieldGuide.rulemaking.lastChecked: ISO date of last manual verification
